initialize.instructions: A small issue tracker. Read a ticket's version with get_ticket and pass it as expected_version when you write.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List all projects with their keys and names.

tools.name: create_project
tools.title: Create a project
tools.description: Create a new project. If a project with this key already exists, nothing is changed and you get an error. Pass an idempotency_key so that retrying after a lost answer is answered with the first result.

key.description: Project key: lower-case letters, digits and dashes. Test runs use their run prefix, e.g. mwsc-<run>-a.

idempotency_key.description: Your own unique key for this create. Sending the same call again with the same key creates nothing new and says it is a replay.

tools.name: delete_project
tools.title: Delete an empty project
tools.description: Delete a project that has no tickets. Delete its tickets first with delete_tickets. Projects carry no version the backend checks, so a delete made from a stale read is not detected.

key.description: Project key: lower-case letters, digits and dashes. Test runs use their run prefix, e.g. mwsc-<run>-a.

tools.name: list_tickets
tools.title: List tickets
tools.description: List tickets, optionally filtered by project, status and title prefix.

project.description: Project key: lower-case letters, digits and dashes. Test runs use their run prefix, e.g. mwsc-<run>-a.

tools.name: get_ticket
tools.title: Get a ticket
tools.description: Read one ticket with its labels (each with a stable label id), comments and current version.

tools.name: create_ticket
tools.title: Create a ticket
tools.description: Create a ticket in a project (default: the server's default project). Pass an idempotency_key so that retrying after a lost answer does not create a second ticket.

project.description: Project key: lower-case letters, digits and dashes. Test runs use their run prefix, e.g. mwsc-<run>-a.

assignee.description: User name, or null to unassign.

description.description: Free text, up to 2000 characters; an empty string clears it.

details.description: Nested details; an update sets only the sub-fields you name.

idempotency_key.description: Your own unique key for this create. Sending the same call again with the same key creates nothing new and says it is a replay.

tools.name: update_ticket
tools.title: Update ticket fields
tools.description: Change only the fields you name; every other field keeps its value. Set assignee to null to unassign. Pass expected_version (from get_ticket): if the ticket changed since, nothing is written and you are told. force: true writes the named fields without that check; use it only when told to.

assignee.description: User name, or null to unassign.

description.description: Free text, up to 2000 characters; an empty string clears it.

details.description: Nested details; an update sets only the sub-fields you name.

expected_version.description: The version you read. If the object changed since, nothing is written and you get a conflict.

force.description: Write the named fields even if the ticket changed since you read it. Default false.

tools.name: replace_ticket
tools.title: Replace a ticket's fields
tools.description: Write all four fields (title, status, assignee, priority) at once, from a version you read. If the ticket changed since expected_version, nothing is written. force: true overwrites anyway; use it only when told to.

expected_version.description: The version you read. If the object changed since, nothing is written and you get a conflict.

assignee.description: User name, or null to unassign.

force.description: Overwrite even if the ticket changed. Default false.

tools.name: delete_ticket
tools.title: Delete a ticket
tools.description: Delete one ticket. Pass expected_version (from get_ticket): if the ticket changed since, nothing is deleted. force: true deletes without that check; use it only when told to.

expected_version.description: The version you read. If the object changed since, nothing is written and you get a conflict.

force.description: Delete even if the ticket changed since you read it. Default false.

tools.name: delete_tickets
tools.title: Delete matching tickets
tools.description: Delete the tickets in one project that match a filter (status and/or title_prefix). With no filter nothing is deleted unless you also pass all: true. All-or-nothing.

project.description: Project key: lower-case letters, digits and dashes. Test runs use their run prefix, e.g. mwsc-<run>-a.

all.description: Required to delete every ticket in the project when no filter is given.

tools.name: close_ticket
tools.title: Close a ticket (asks for confirmation)
tools.description: Close a ticket. The server first asks you to confirm (an input_required result); nothing is written until you retry with the confirmation.

tools.name: bulk_update_tickets
tools.title: Update several tickets
tools.description: Set status and/or assignee on several tickets of one project. All-or-nothing: if any ticket cannot be updated, none is, and the result says which ticket stopped it.

project.description: Project key: lower-case letters, digits and dashes. Test runs use their run prefix, e.g. mwsc-<run>-a.

assignee.description: User name, or null to unassign.

tools.name: add_comment
tools.title: Add a comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a ticket. Returns the new comment's id. Pass an idempotency_key so that retrying after a lost answer does not post the comment twice.

idempotency_key.description: Your own unique key for this create. Sending the same call again with the same key creates nothing new and says it is a replay.

tools.name: add_label
tools.title: Add a label
tools.description: Add one label to a ticket. Adding a label the ticket already has changes nothing. Returns the label's stable id.

tools.name: remove_label
tools.title: Remove a label
tools.description: Remove one label from a ticket by its label id (from get_ticket). The id stays valid when other labels change.

tools.name: set_labels
tools.title: Replace all labels
tools.description: Replace a ticket's whole label list with the names given; labels not listed are removed. Pass the expected_version you read; if the ticket changed since, nothing is written. force: true replaces the list without that check; use it only when told to. To add or remove one label, use add_label or remove_label.

expected_version.description: The version you read. If the object changed since, nothing is written and you get a conflict.

force.description: Replace the list even if the ticket changed. Default false.

tools.name: add_label

tools.name: remove_label
